definitions.explanation: The paper, film, or containers used to wrap a product for display and sale. Discussed often in connection with waste reduction and recycling.

examples.japanese: {包装材|ほうそうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らしたい→減らす：02414_herasu⟧。
examples.english: We want to reduce packaging material.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{包装材|ほうそうざい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}えた→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧。
examples.english: We switched to paper packaging material.

examples.japanese: ⟦{使|つか}い{捨|す}て→使い捨て：07665_tsukaisute⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{包装材|ほうそうざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{汚染|おせん}→汚染：02595_osen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{指摘|してき}→指摘：05630_shiteki⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It has been pointed out that disposable packaging material contributes to ocean pollution.

notes:
⟦{包装|ほうそう}→包装：11932_housou⟧ (wrapping, packaging) + ⟦{材|ざい}→〜材：28347_zai⟧ (material). Refers to what the product is presented in on the shelf, rather than what protects it in transit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {包装材|ほうそうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧: to reduce packaging material
- ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{優|やさ}しい{包装材|ほうそうざい}: environmentally friendly packaging
- {包装材|ほうそうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回収|かいしゅう}する→回収する：21142_kaishuusuru⟧: to collect packaging for recycling

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{梱包材|こんぽうざい}→梱包材：30141_konpouzai⟧: packing material — cushioning and boxes used for shipping
- ⟦{容器|ようき}→容器：03656_youki⟧: container — the vessel itself, such as a bottle or tub
